scope: Independent read-only source audit of final reported-via child stage, joint integration and exact source/test identities. No whole-board speed or no-regression claim.

resolvedFinding.finalFix: Three-line conservative eligibility guard declines a reported via whose normalized parent PCB trace ID matches any current SRJ preloaded trace ID. New real reference-DRC test verifies attemptfalse, mergerundefined, remaining1 and input/preload immutability.

findings.conclusion: New wrapper reuses byte-unchanged Pipeline9ReportedViaMergeSolver and pinned SameNetViaMergerSolver, adding no duplicate geometric algorithm. It requires exactly one explicit two-distinct-ID via-clearance error, actual circuit via lookup, finite centers, matching drill/annulus/layer arrays, overlapping same-net via copper, mapped eligible new routes, exclusion of synthetic/preloaded identities and conservative normalized-ID collision rejection.

Only the two eligible new route indices may differ; every other combined route must remain exact JSON-identical. Fixed preloaded route objects are outside the merger candidate set. Exact route endpoint JSON, terminals, jumper/through-obstacle metadata points, route identity/root/width/diameter/jumpers and existing fixed/noneligible centerline via contacts are checked before publication. Noneligible routes include synthetic preload sections.

Eligibility requires reported pair drill diameter, outer diameter and layer arrays to match. The pinned reused merger structured-clones movable routes and changes only XY on existing layer-transition clusters; it spreads original point metadata and retains point z/width values. Route-level traceThickness and viaDiameter are additionally checked. Final full-reference validation includes declared hole spacing and board clearance with the same existing preloaded-baseline contract.

findings.topic: No false clean or silent fallback
findings.conclusion: Publication requires existing merger accepted=true, reference errors exactly0 and protected-copper checks passing. Otherwise original route array and original nonzero remaining issue count remain, with repaired=false. Ineligible inputs explicitly finish with unchanged routes and actual error count. Missing internal inputs, unresolved reported via identities, inconsistent reference identity capture and premature getResult throw; no solver exception is caught and continued.

Actual full reference evaluator captures remapped CircuitJSON during the exact unchanged-board validation; wrapper checks reported error type/via IDs/actual/minimum clearance identity against its cached reference result. Captured rich CircuitJSON remains local to eligibility and does not enter either DRC candidate cache. No suffix-based via-ID inference is used.

The existing reference evaluator includes board clearance, trace continuity and declared via-hole clearances using the original/point-pair connection maps. Its existing baseline-error filtering remains unchanged. Consequently zero refers to this established full reference candidate contract, not a new claim that every raw preloaded manufacturing defect is absent.

Final merge is an explicit joint pipeline child after bounded regional repair. Parent and wrapper call child.step(), not blocking child.solve(). Child failed state propagates; thrown invariants propagate through BaseSolver. Reused SameNetViaMerger has fixed1e6iterationcap; parent/wrapper budget propagation accounts for child remaining steps without waiving failure. Existing early-complete reference-clean paths correctly bypass the unnecessary final stage.

The final pass reports attempted/repaired, actual initial/published remaining issue counts and reference validator call count separately from prior bounded-stage metrics. Existing aggregate referenceDrcValidationCount still counts actual cache-miss evaluator executions. The local final-pass validation count includes invocation/check requests and should not be described as all fresh expensive evaluations.

Focused tests cover real reference clean repair, endpoint protection, distinct-net rejection, foreign-pad rejection, immutable preload rejection and actual normalized preload-ID collision rejection. Stage test checks sequential step advancement and absence of blocking solve calls; its injected child-failure test is an earlier exact child, while final wrapper failure propagation was inspected statically. All30 frozen protocol files byte-match their manifest.

qualification: The reused merger can coalesce additional nearby same-net vias within the two eligible route objects; source does not guarantee that only the originally reported pair moves. Every candidate remains subject to full reference0 and protected-copper checks.
